subject.title: Telegram polling-liveness monitor fires "⚠️ 🔌 Gateway failed" on non-fatal tool-call rejections

question: Should this be fixed as default Telegram tool-progress wording/context only, or should Telegram also add a new alert severity filter config option for fatal-only suppression?
rationale: The misleading default looks like a valid UX bug, but the requested severity filter is a new user-facing config surface and repository policy sets a high bar for new config knobs.

options.title: Default classification only
options.body: Repair the existing progress/alert wording so protected-path and approval-style rejections are visibly non-fatal and include useful context without adding config.

options.title: Add severity filtering too
options.body: Add a Telegram alert-severity option with schema, docs, tests, and upgrade proof if maintainers want operator-controlled suppression.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Leave generic failed-tool wording as-is and document the workaround, accepting continued confusion for expected gateway rejections.

recommendation.title: Default classification only
recommendation.body: Repair the existing progress/alert wording so protected-path and approval-style rejections are visibly non-fatal and include useful context without adding config.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main sampled files and recent blame point most strongly to this handle for the affected tool-progress and Telegram rendering surface.
